collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: Children run back and forth along the shore, chasing the waves and fleeing them.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: Children run back and forth along the shore, chasing the waves and fleeing them. One wave catches them all, and they shriek with delight.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: Children run back and forth along the shore, chasing the waves and fleeing them. A dog joins the game and is better at it than anyone.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: Children run back and forth along the shore, chasing the waves and fleeing them. They keep score, though nobody is sure how.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: Children run back and forth along the shore, chasing the waves and fleeing them. An elder watches from the dry sand, remembering playing the same game.
